entries.note: “Hardly an endorsement” is a rhetorical assessment of progress. The embedded claim about what Musk omitted from the call is separately checkable.

entries.test: Public investigation findings, regulatory statements, and stakeholder responses could establish whether Cruise’s initial nondisclosure substantially damaged trust in the company.
entries.note: “Apparently” marks the evidence as provisional; it does not merely assert a future possibility.

entries.test: Public safety evaluations and technical accounts of autonomous driving systems could test whether reliable, safer-than-human driving requires the stated reasoning capabilities and fundamental research beyond existing statistical approaches.
entries.note: This asserts a technical necessity, rather than merely recommending a research direction. A demonstrated system achieving the outcome without those requirements would rebut it.

entries.test: Research funding, staffing, and project allocation records around October 2023, together with public explanations of allocation decisions, could establish whether enthusiasm for LLMs substantially crowded out the described fundamental research.
entries.note: “Starved out” has a plain resource-allocation reading in this context. The surrounding discussion explicitly mentions difficulty obtaining funding.
